description: Convert one pay figure into annual, monthly, semimonthly, biweekly, weekly and hourly pay. Send the amount and what it is (annual, monthly, semimonthly, biweekly, weekly or hourly), and optionally the hours it pays for: hours_per_week (default 40, so a 2,080-hour year) or annual_hours (for example 2,087, the federal civil service divisor). Get back every figure to the cent, the hourly rate to 4 decimals, the hours used, and a flag when the hourly figure is below the federal minimum wage (29 U.S.C. 206). Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/salary-hourly-convert). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

amount.description: The pay figure you have (up to 4 decimals), in dollars.

annual_hours.description: Hours in the pay year if you use a set divisor, e.g. 2087 (5 U.S.C. 5504) or 1950. Send this or hours_per_week, not both.

basis.description: What the amount is: pay per year, per month, per half month (24 a year), per two weeks (26 a year), per week (52 a year) or per hour.

hours_per_week.description: Hours the pay is meant to cover each week (default 40). Annual hours = hours_per_week x 52. Send this or annual_hours, not both.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'analyst offer' (your own text, echoed; not a person's name).

name: salary_hourly_convert
title: Salary and Hourly Pay Conversion
